normalized.description:
Please note that this is not a call for tenders but a publication announcing the Contracting authority’s intention to publish a future negotiated low or middle valueprocedure. 
The goal is to have a worldwide coverage for the European Union Civil Protection (EUCP) team members for professional and public third-party liability. The coverage shall be for bodily and personal injury, material and non-material damage and financial loss. The members of the EUCP teams are not insured on this risk by their own organisation. This is part of the duty of care of the European Commission to have an insurance covering such a risk.

Present prototype and pilot findings, user feedback, technical constraints, trade-offs, implementation risks, and scaling recommendations to CAPDEV leaders and stakeholders.
